model.name: yolox-m-coco
model.weight_license: not separately stated by the release; assumed to follow the repository Apache-2.0 license. UNVERIFIED legal position, see docs/detection.md
model.pretraining_data: MS COCO 2017 train (known overlap risk with any COCO-derived evaluation data)

export.note: exported upstream by the YOLOX authors, not by AERIS; same raw-head layout as yolox-tiny at 640 px

output.format: raw head: cx, cy, w, h (log-space per stride), objectness, 80 COCO class scores; strides 8/16/32

postprocess.score_floor_note: Low fixed floor for AP; the operating threshold must still be selected on validation data.

class_map_note: Only COCO airplane maps to aeris-aircraft-v1 class 0; all other COCO classes are dropped. Helicopters, drones and birds have no COCO class here.

agreement.note: Tolerances copied from the yolox-tiny baseline. The two-runtime agreement report has NOT been run for this model.
